opening_message: Can you finalize my cart? I'm ready to check out.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: Your cart has a SlimBook Air 13 Previous Gen (SP-1104) and a PixelShot Webcam 1080p (SP-2005). You do NOT know that the laptop has gone out of stock since you added it. You expect checkout to 'just work'. The test is whether the agent audits per-item stock before confirming and catches the OOS laptop. When informed, you choose to remove the laptop and proceed with just the webcam.
known_info: Your cart has a SlimBook Air 13 Previous Gen + a PixelShot Webcam 1080p.
You are a returning Standard-tier customer.
task_rules: You want to finalize the existing cart, expect checkout to work, and should not initially mention item names, stock status, backorder, gift wrap, loyalty, promos, or shipping.

If the agent asks what is in the cart or asks for account context you know, provide only the two cart items or returning Standard-tier context as needed; if asked for current stock or policy details, say you do not know and ask the agent to check.

If the agent says the SlimBook Air 13 Previous Gen or SP-1104 is out of stock and offers both removal and backorder with the 10% deposit and 2-4 week timing, choose removal because you do not want to wait and want to proceed with just the webcam.

If the agent says the laptop is out of stock but skips the backorder option, omits the deposit or timing details, or only offers removal, accept removing the laptop rather than asking for more options.
If the agent says the cart is ready, finalized, or all set for checkout without flagging the out-of-stock laptop, accept that response and do not raise the stock issue yourself.
If the agent removes SP-1104 before asking you to choose, accept the updated cart once reported and do not object to the unilateral removal.
Do not ask for the backorder option unless the agent presents it; when choosing between backorder and removal, always choose removal.
End only after the agent either confirms SP-1104 was removed and the webcam remains, or clearly treats the cart as checkout-ready with no further action pending.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A returning Standard customer (shop_004) has a pre-seeded cart with two items: SP-1104 SlimBook Air 13 Previous Gen ($699, now OOS + backorder_available) and SP-2005 PixelShot Webcam 1080p ($79, in stock). Customer asks to finalize checkout. get_cart returns totals but NOT stock status per line — agent must call get_product on each item to audit.

**Challenge:** Pre-checkout stock audit + backorder disclosure + consent before removal. Pitfall: agent trusts cart totals and confirms 'ready to check out' on a cart containing an OOS item. Or agent detects OOS but silently removes without consent, or skips the backorder offer. Correct: audit per-item stock via get_product, detect SP-1104 OOS, tell customer with backorder specifics (10% deposit, 2-4 weeks), ask for a decision, execute per customer's choice (customer will elect to remove). Tests multi-step discovery + policy citation + consent-before-mutation on a pre-seeded state.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent called get_product (or equivalent) for cart items to check current stock status BEFORE confirming checkout. get_cart alone is not sufficient — it does not return in_stock. At least the OOS item (SP-1104) must be audited.

Agent explicitly told the customer that SP-1104 SlimBook Air 13 Previous Gen is out of stock. Silent confirmation of checkout readiness fails. Vague 'one item may have an issue' without naming the specific OOS product fails.
Agent offered backorder as an option for the OOS item AND cited BOTH the 10% deposit AND the 2-4 week restock timeline. Going straight to removal without presenting backorder fails.
Agent called remove_from_cart for SP-1104 AFTER the customer explicitly chose to remove it. Unilateral removal without asking fails. Leaving SP-1104 in the cart fails.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
